set_text.text: Balances you no longer expect to collect still sit in average receivables and drag the ratio down. Written-off debt has left it, so compare years on the same basis.
The 9% should be what your credit line charges, or what the cash would earn. A guess there moves the yearly cost, though never the days.
Where VOS sits before the invoice
The order comes before the invoice

VOS does not invoice, collect or keep your books. Its part comes earlier: customers review each line before sending, and each VOS app order carries a number, date and timestamp. If an account questions an invoice, you have a record of what was ordered and when.
Order history per account in one admin platform
Confirmations reach accounts by notification and text
Orders reach you in the format you already use
Works alongside your ERP, nothing to rip out
